name: CRT curvature
summary: Old-TV screen frame: dark bezel with rounded, bulging screen corners, inner vignette and faint scanlines.

params.name: scan
params.note: scanline strength inside the screen, 0 to 1

params.name: vignette
params.note: darkening toward the screen edges, 0 to 1

params.name: seed
params.note: change to give a separate instance its own ids

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at
